_comment: required=false plus require=0 on every injection: a rename in a future Minecraft
version disables one feature instead of refusing to launch.
Per-version differences are compiled in (tools/eras.py); the plugin only skips
mixins whose com.aetherium.Capabilities flag is false on this version and records
which mixins applied (shown on the Backend page).
The plugin lives outside the mixin package because Aetherium references it directly.
Client-only on purpose: a dedicated server has no renderer to hook.
